questions.prompt: What does a healthcheck do in Compose?

options.text: It runs a probe command periodically to report the container as healthy or unhealthy

questions.explanation: A healthcheck runs a test command on an interval and marks the container healthy, unhealthy, or starting based on the result.

questions.prompt: How do you make a web service wait until its database is truly ready?

options.text: Give the database a healthcheck and set depends_on with condition: service_healthy on the web service
Add a sleep to the database image

questions.explanation: depends_on alone only orders startup. Combined with a healthcheck and condition: service_healthy, the dependent service waits until the dependency reports healthy.

questions.prompt: What are Compose profiles used for?

options.text: Including a service only when its profile is activated, for optional tools or one-off jobs

questions.explanation: A service with profiles: ["debug"] starts only when you activate that profile (docker compose --profile debug up), which suits optional debuggers, seeders, and migrations.

questions.prompt: To load environment variables into a service from a separate file, use the ______ key. (one word, with underscore)
questions.explanation: env_file loads variables from a separate file, keeping configuration and secrets out of the committed Compose file.

options.text: The fully merged and interpolated configuration, so you can verify overrides and variables
A list of images on Docker Hub

questions.explanation: docker compose config resolves overrides and ${VAR} interpolation and prints the final configuration, which is invaluable for debugging multi-file setups.

questions.prompt: Which statements about advanced Compose features are true? Select all that apply.

options.text: Custom networks can isolate tiers so a frontend cannot reach a backend-only service
Override files let you layer environment-specific changes on a shared base
A healthcheck that only checks the process exists is a thorough readiness probe

questions.explanation: Networks isolate tiers, override files layer config, and ${VAR:-default} supplies a fallback. A probe that only checks the process is running is not a real readiness check.
